component.name: Etichetta
component.summary: A YOLO annotator, for human beings

description.p: Etichetta is a simple and efficient tool designed for annotating images for YOLO object detection. It provides a user-friendly interface to quickly draw, edit, and label bounding boxes.

ul.li: Zoom into specific areas for precise labeling
AI-assisted annotation with your own ONNX model
Lightweight and optimized for human annotators

description.p: New project window and "Add pictures to project". AI assist supports YOLOv5/v7, YOLOv8 to YOLO26 and RT-DETR models, runs on the GPU through WebGPU, and a script trains a model from your project. Status bar, AI badge, a margin around the picture, Flatpak support and many fixes.
Rebuilt with up-to-date compilers and dependencies.
Faster AI inference, frame extraction from video, copy and paste.
